en.headline: Mainland bar-restaurant chain Commune opens first Hong Kong outlet
en.dek: The flagship store at Lee Garden Three in Causeway Bay marks the start of the chain’s overseas expansion, with plans for more locations and a regional headquarters in the city.
body: Mainland China-based bar and restaurant chain Commune has opened its first outlet in Hong Kong at Lee Garden Three in Causeway Bay, serving as the company’s flagship store in the city.

Co-founder and chief brand officer Fan Xiameng said the group is deeply committed to Hong Kong and plans to open additional locations over the next 12 months. Commune also intends to establish its regional headquarters in Hong Kong to oversee international expansion.
The chain operates more than 100 outlets across the mainland and offers food and beverages throughout the day. The Causeway Bay opening forms part of its overseas expansion strategy.

zh.headline: 內地酒吧餐廳連鎖Commune首店進駐銅鑼灣
zh.dek: 旗艦店位於利園三期，計劃一年內再開分店，並在港設立地區總部統籌海外擴展。
body: 內地酒吧餐廳連鎖品牌Commune已於銅鑼灣利園三期開設香港首間分店，作為集團在港旗艦店。
聯合創辦人兼首席品牌官范夏萌表示，集團對香港有深厚承諾，計劃未來12個月再開更多分店，並會在港設立地區總部，統籌國際擴展。
Commune於內地經營逾100間分店，全日供應餐飲。是次銅鑼灣開業屬其海外擴展策略的一部分。
